evidence:
Pass. Reference is a static committed baseline in the frozen snapshot (.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r7/task), byte-identical to projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations/solution (diff -rq clean); seed copy solution/app/src/seed_data.json == environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c80...3740).
(1) Not regenerated/fetched: solution/solve.sh only checks DB inactivity via /proc, runs `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` and removes the DB/WAL/SHM; no npm install, no curl/wget, no build or code generation. package.json pins exact better-sqlite3 12.4.1 / express 5.1.0, matching environment/Dockerfile's `npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1` via NODE_PATH. index.html loads only /styles.css and /js/{board,threads,app}.js (no CDN or off-origin fetch); app.js fetch() targets same-origin API paths only.
(2) Deterministic seeding: src/db.js:10 reads seed_data.json beside the module (not cwd, not /assets); seedIfEmpty (db.js:61-86) runs only when users is empty, inserts users/jobs/applications with seed ids, positions and a constant created_at '2026-06-15T09:00:00Z' (db.js:75); messages inserted in seed order with AUTOINCREMENT ids and seed created_at (130 fixed timestamps in seed); read markers resolved deterministically as ids[app][read_count-1]; notes use seed timestamps; password is the public brief credential. No Math.random/Date.now in seeding. Same seed -> same rows/ids every fresh install.
(3) Time: the brief and rules state no fixed clock and no graded time rule (grep of instruction.md, hireops_rules.md, integration.md, app_context.md and all judge prompts for clock/today/ago found none); new runtime records take now() (src/index.js:59) which is not a pinned value. Display formatting is pinned to UTC/en-GB (public/js/app.js:21). Orderings that are graded (board column order: position,id; Activity newest-first: ORDER BY a.id DESC index.js:189; messages by id) use monotonic integers/positions, not wall clock.
(4) Randomness only in runtime-created identifiers: uid() = crypto.randomBytes(3) for new JOB-/APP- ids (index.js:60,208,226) and session tokens (index.js:88); these are not pinned values, are never named by criteria (judges create their own jobs/cards), and 24-bit collision would only matter at negligible probability.
Minor P3 observation (not a defect for this row): candidate application list orders by created_at, id (index.js:173); two runtime-created applications for one candidate in the same millisecond would tie-break on a random id, but created_at is ISO ms precision and no criterion grades that order.
Runtime corroboration: raw-evidence-index.json (input_sha256 matches) artifact hashes re-verified True for all 6 entries; qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json records 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages and activity without reseeding'. I did not run two fresh seeds and diff them; code reading is sufficient for this static-determinism row and no required measurement for it is missing.
Adversarial: a broken golden that fetched seed from network or reseeded each boot would be caught here (it does neither); a conforming alternative using random ids for runtime records would not be penalised by this row or by criteria, which use names not ids.
